queries.query: Does Article 5(1)(b) of Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2025/301 support this requirement: Submit without undue delay after regular activities have recovered, when the incident status changes materially, or when the competent authority requests it

Which provision of Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2025/301 is materially necessary for this requirement but absent from the existing mapping: Submit without undue delay after regular activities have recovered, when the incident status changes materially, or when the competent authority requests it

item.control_statement: Submit without undue delay after regular activities have recovered, when the incident status changes materially, or when the competent authority requests it
